name: Karla Rosales
title: Director, Product Design
quote: Ji-Sook is one of the most reliable and strategic design leaders I've collaborated with and managed. Her attention to detail and ability to make all stakeholders feel heard while structuring experiences is a skill that's hard to find. I could focus on other areas knowing that the platforms under her leadership were consistently achieving their goals. Beyond delivering results, she genuinely cares about nurturing design craft and helping designers grow.
